lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.unitTitle: Data: Scaled Graphs and Measurement Line Plots
lessonRef.title: Synthesis and review: representing and interpreting data

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: On a scaled bar graph with 1 per symbol, "Apples" has 4 symbols and "Bananas" has 1 symbols. How many more does "Apples" have than "Bananas"?
A line plot shows the lengths of 8 leaves, each measured to the nearest 1/4 inch: 4/4, 3/4, 2/4, 4/4, 4/4, 2/4, 1/4, 3/4. How many leaves measured exactly 3/4 inch?
A scaled bar graph shows a survey where each bar length equals a count of 5 per symbol. The bar for "Bananas" is worth 1 symbols. How many does "Bananas" represent?
On a scaled bar graph with 10 per symbol, "Dogs" has 3 symbols and "Cats" has 2 symbols. How many more does "Dogs" have than "Cats"?
A line plot shows the lengths of 8 leaves, each measured to the nearest 1/8 inch: 1/8, 4/8, 6/8, 2/8, 6/8, 3/8, 7/8, 6/8. How many leaves measured exactly 6/8 inch?
A scaled bar graph shows a survey where each bar length equals a count of 10 per symbol. The bar for "Red" is worth 8 symbols. How many does "Red" represent?

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt: On a scaled bar graph with 5 per symbol, "Dogs" has 7 symbols and "Cats" has 3 symbols. How many more does "Dogs" have than "Cats"?
A line plot shows the lengths of 8 leaves, each measured to the nearest 1/4 inch: 1/4, 3/4, 4/4, 2/4, 2/4, 1/4, 3/4, 1/4. How many leaves measured exactly 1/4 inch?
A scaled bar graph shows a survey where each bar length equals a count of 5 per symbol. The bar for "Birds" is worth 8 symbols. How many does "Birds" represent?
